name: Dong Xuan Market
kicker: Covered wholesale market at the north end of the lanes
summary: Dong Xuan is the big covered market at the north end of the Old Quarter, with Chợ Đồng Xuân across its front. Inside are three floors of wholesale stalls: clothes and accessories at ground level, bolts of cloth, and dry goods in the Bac Qua section. Come for the trading floor more than for souvenirs, and walk it together with Bach Ma.
heroCaption: The Chợ Đồng Xuân front, from the street

notice.title: Stall hours shift
notice.body: Stall hours change around holidays and while the hall is under repair, and a 2026–2027 renovation is planned. Confirm the hall is open before you make it the morning’s goal.

body: The market is the covered hall at the north end of the lanes, on Dong Xuan street, with Chợ Đồng Xuân across the front and the management office at 1A Cau Dong. It runs over three floors, with clothes and accessories on the ground floor and a dry-goods section called Bac Qua.

Inside, the cloth stalls are the frame people recognize: bolts of every colour stacked high along the aisles. Wholesale goods are the point of the hall more than a souvenir list, so come to watch the trade.
The hall opens at 06:00 and closes at 18:00, staying open until 22:30 on Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. Go in the morning, then walk back south through the lanes.

gettingThere: Walk north from Hoan Kiem Lake through the lanes to Dong Xuan street, about 800 m to 2 km on foot. Bach Ma, at 76 Hang Buom, is on the way.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem Lake
legs.body: On foot, north through the lanes, about 800 m to 2 km.

hours: 06:00–18:00 daily, until 22:30 Friday–Sunday (Dan Tri, Oct 2023). Stall hours can change around holidays and repairs (Travel.com.vn).
closed: No weekly close (Dan Tri, Oct 2023). A 2026–2027 renovation is planned (Travel.com.vn); check for closures.
admissionNote: No entry ticket; shopping and food are paid separately (Travel.com.vn). Dan Tri lists no fee. Confirm at the door.
